network.title: No connection
network.description: Check your internet connection and try again.

code.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the details are invalid. Check the form and try again.
code.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
code.JOB_NOT_FOUND: This generation is no longer available.
code.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT: This request was already sent with different details. Start the generation again.
code.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The generation service was unavailable. The same request may work later.
code.NO_VALID_CONTENT: Nothing usable could be generated. Try a more specific topic.
code.GENERATION_FAILED: The cards could not be generated. Try a more specific topic.
code.DOCUMENT_UNREADABLE: This file could not be read. Re-export it and try again.
code.DOCUMENT_ENCRYPTED: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the protection and upload it again.
code.DOCUMENT_HAS_NO_TEXT: This file has no text to read — scans and photos have no text layer.
code.DOCUMENT_REJECTED: This file's content cannot be turned into cards.
code.DOCUMENT_REGENERATION_UNSUPPORTED: Cards made from an uploaded file cannot be regenerated yet.
code.DOCUMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_GENERATION: Recordings cannot be turned into cards on this server.
code.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: This file is no longer available. Upload it again.
code.UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
code.UNSUPPORTED_RECORDING_URL: This link is not a single YouTube video.
code.RECORDING_UNAVAILABLE: This video cannot be used — it is private, removed, restricted or live.
code.UNSUPPORTED_ARTICLE_URL: This link is not a public web page.
code.ARTICLE_UNAVAILABLE: This page could not be opened.
code.ARTICLE_BLOCKED_BY_ROBOTS: This site does not allow its pages to be read automatically.
code.ARTICLE_HAS_NO_TEXT: This page has no readable article text.
code.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: This version of the app cannot reach the service. Try updating it.
code.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This version of the app is out of step with the service. Try updating it.
code.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side.

generation.timeout: This is taking longer than expected. You can keep waiting or cancel the generation.

service.unavailable: The generation service cannot be reached. Check your connection before generating.
service.degraded: The generation service is running slowly. Generation may take longer than usual.
